item.title: Owl AI Declares One Olympic Snowboarding Medal Change Following Judging Controversies
item.description: Mari Fukada delivered two 720s and took Gold with a 87.83. Zoi Sadowski-Synott, whose run was objectively more progressive and riskier, won Silver with 87.48.

item.title: 25,000 People Showed Up for Red Bull Heavy Metal, and No One Was Disappointed
item.description: The Red Bull Heavy Metal event is an interesting one. It's a snowboarding contest, yes, but it's not held in the mountains. It's held in the streets.

item.title: The Best Parawings: Tested and Ranked for Foiling Freedom
item.description: Parawings are the latest and greatest invention in the world of windsports. We tested the best on the market to give you our honest feedback.

item.title: Santa Cruz Man Pleads Not Guilty to Alleged Surf Rage Stabbing
item.description: Shannon Stanger, 59, pleaded not guilty to the charges of assault with a deadly weapon stemming from an April 27 argument at the Hook in Santa Cruz.

item.title: 20 Minutes of Kelly Slater Surfing in Bali Over the Last 6 Years
item.description: Kelly Slater has been surfing in Bali for a long time. He knows the waves, knows the people, and loves it all. This is 20 minutes of him doing what he does.

item.title: World Surf League Announces 4-Stop Longboard Tour, World Title Format Change
item.description: The World Surf League's longboard tour will include for stops, including a new location. The world champion will also be decided on cumulative points.

item.title: The Eddie Won’t Go: Surfing’s Most Prestigious Event Called Off for This Season
item.description: The Eddie Aikau Invitational is the most prestigious event in all of surfing. But this year, it's not running. Conditions at Waimea aren't expected to line up.

item.title: 3,300 Pounds of Shark Fins Seized in Brazilian Raid Connected to Chinese Syndicate
item.description: Authorities in Brazil arrested seven people last month in connection with a shark finning operation. They seized 1.5 tons of shark fins during the raid.

item.title: The Surf Around Los Angeles In February Was Solid
item.description: This is a short recap of a super-fun month of surfing around Los Angeles. We had a good run of surf throughout February.

item.title: Why I Find Myself Competing Against the Snowboarder I Used to Be
item.description: The author spent years chasing powder in Lake Tahoe. Snowboarding was everything. But today, he finds himself competing against the snowboarder he used to be.
